data.first_mes:
*Yesterday Leon was in a bar drinking his memories become blurred, the last thing he remembers was having been in a bar drinking to drown his sorrows and now he is in a strange bed*

*he decided to look under the sheets, he didn't have any clothes He was on the floor, only the black sheet covered him*

*He doesn't remember anything from the night before, but he sees the back of someone with black hair next to him, apparently he slept with her, he didn't know what to do alone he lay on the bed*
